title: #88: Run a reviewer alone for evals
body:
Closes #88

## Summary

`runReviewer` can now run outside a Run: the diff it is given and the metered model chat come from shared functions, not from inside `app.ts`.

```diff
 src/
 ├── app.ts            # Run now calls reviewScope and meteredChat
+├── scope.ts          # reviewScope(source, { exclude, tokenBudget }) → { files, excluded, scope, diff }
+├── reviewer.ts       # meteredChat(...) moved here; runReviewer takes optional `system`; `prompt` exported
 scripts/
+└── eval-reviewer.ts  # one focus on one pinned PR → { findings | error, transcript, usage } JSON
```

```text
eval-reviewer case.json
  openSource            # repository copy kept in $TMPDIR/reviewer-eval
  reviewScope           # same exclusions and token budget as a Run
  runReviewer
    chat (wrapped)      # keeps the growing message array = full tool transcript
      meteredChat       # same model, fallback, token budget as a Run
```

Repo config parsing and the reviews after a push (`diffSince`, `fresh`, `newcomers`) stay in `app.ts`.

## Evidence

- **Before:** no way to get the reviewer's diff without a whole Run.
  **After:** new test `reviewScope leaves excluded and over-budget files out of the diff and says which they were` (git fixture → `openSource` → `reviewScope`): an `exclude` glob match and an over-budget file are missing from `diff`, and listed in `excluded` and `scope.skipped`. It failed before `reviewScope` existed and passes now.
- Behavior of a Run is unchanged: the existing suite passes unmodified (191/191), and `npm run typecheck` is clean.
- Script error path, run offline against a `file://` case with bad SHAs: prints `{ "error": "…not our ref…", "transcript": [], "usage": {…} }` and exits 1. It has not been run against a live model.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

A pure refactor plus a new script; revert restores the old code.

**Blast Radius:** small

Every Run goes through the moved code, so a mistake there would affect reviews; the unchanged harness tests cover diff building, exclusions and token budgets.

expected.defect: meteredChat is given no fallbackModel, so an eval runs a different model setup from the App

acceptableExtras.title: Key the eval cache by the full URL
